purpose: Test the frozen v13 output and budget-terminal boundaries on the consumed Q10 trajectory that previously ended after three empty final responses.

trigger_evidence.selection_rule: Reuse the unique Q10 calibration run with consecutive empty-final policy failures; do not inspect or select a new identity.

official_protocol.access: post-episode only after an internal pass

primary_outcomes: completed responses, parsed candidates, fresh executions, and token usage
secondary_outcomes: internal pass and natural Official evaluator reach

decision_rule.practical_output_qualification: At least five completed responses produce parsed candidates without candidate-policy-output failure, empty-final diagnostic, or request error.
decision_rule.budget_terminal_qualification: If the online budget terminates the run, the terminal failure is episode-budget-exhausted with its exact scope and no budget message is classified as candidate-policy-exception.
decision_rule.contradicted: Any empty-final policy failure under the frozen contract, persisted reasoning content, or budget exhaustion classified as a policy exception blocks unseen qualification.
decision_rule.unexercised: An earlier internal Pass, infrastructure Unknown, or provider exception prevents the relevant boundary from being observed; report without replacement.

adaptation_policy.pre_episode_acquisition_failure: one audited same-identity retry only when model, candidate, environment, command, and evaluator usage are all zero
adaptation_policy.other_failure: record the observed outcome without retry or adaptation
